annotations.title: Find a county veterans service officer

description: Find a County Veterans Service Officer (CVSO) — free claims helpers, usually county employees (state or regional officers in some states), who help veterans file VA disability and pension claims. Not every county has its own office. Use this when a veteran needs help filing a VA claim but does not want to pay a private attorney.
